function resolveLegacySlug(slug: string) {
  const cleanSlug = normalizeSlug(slug);
  return LEGACY_SLUG_ALIASES[cleanSlug] || cleanSlug;
}

function getDetailBySlug(slug: string) {
  const targetSlug = resolveLegacySlug(slug);

  return getDetailList().find((item) => {
    const candidates = [
      getRecordSlug(item),
      normalizeSlug(item.slug),
      normalizeSlug(item.detailSlug),
      normalizeModelToSlug(item.model),
      normalizeModelToSlug(item.productId),
    ].filter(Boolean);

    return candidates.includes(targetSlug);
  });
}

export function generateStaticParams() {

{
  "seriesId": "DPL30",
  "slug": "dpl30-liquid-diaphragm-pump",
  "category": "液体隔膜泵",
  "title": "DPL30 液体隔膜泵",
  "displayName": "DPL30 液体隔膜泵",
  "path": "/products/pumps/diaphragm-pumps/dpl30-liquid-diaphragm-pump",
  "description": "DPL30 液体隔膜泵是一款面向仪器内部液路系统的紧凑型液体输送泵，适用于清洗液输送、试剂转移、废液抽排、管路预充和小流量液体循环等场景。该系列采用隔膜泵结构，可在有限空间内实现稳定液体输送，适合体外诊断设备、生命科学仪器、实验室自动化设备和分析检测系统中的液路模块集成。\n\nDPL30 系列额定流量为 300 mL/min，额定压力为 100 kPa，自吸高度为 6 mH₂O，提供有刷电机和无刷电机两种标准型号配置。用户可根据设备运行时间、寿命要求和成本需求直接选择对应型号；如需 12V 电压、FF/PS 材质组合或其他接口方向，可在型号配置中进一步确认。",
  "commonApplications": "清洗液输送、试剂转移、废液抽排、管路预充、小流量液体循环",
  "modelDisplay": "型号：DPL30 标准型号",
  "modelButtonText": "型号配置",
  "status": "首版完整",

    "description": "DPL30 无刷液体隔膜泵适用于需要更长寿命和连续运行的仪器液路系统，流量 300 mL/min，额定压力 100 kPa。",

      "question": "DPL30 液体隔膜泵适合哪些应用？",
      "answer": "DPL30 液体隔膜泵适用于仪器内部清洗液输送、试剂转移、废液抽排、管路预充和小流量液体循环等场景。对于需要 300 mL/min 流量、100 kPa 额定压力和紧凑结构的液路系统，DPL30 可作为常规液体输送模块集成到体外诊断设备、生命科学仪器、实验室自动化设备和分析检测系统中。",

  "seriesId": "DPL30H",
  "slug": "dpl30h-liquid-diaphragm-pump",
  "category": "液体隔膜泵",

  "displayName": "DPL30H 液体隔膜泵",
  "path": "/products/pumps/diaphragm-pumps/dpl30h-liquid-diaphragm-pump",
  "description": "DPL30H 液体隔膜泵是一款适用于较高出口压力液路系统的隔膜泵，适合用于仪器内部液体输送、试剂转移、加压供液、较长管路输送和阻力较高的液路模块。该系列在 300 mL/min 流量基础上提供 600 kPa 额定压力，适合对出口压力要求高于常规液体隔膜泵的设备系统。\n\nDPL30H 系列支持有刷电机和无刷电机版本，采用卡套接头结构，可连接 6×4 mm 硬管，适合需要稳定管路连接和较高压力输送的仪器内部液路集成。对于需要 300 mL/min 流量、600 kPa 额定压力和硬管连接方式的应用，DPL30H 可作为液体输送、管路供液和加压液路模块的隔膜泵方案。",
  "commonApplications": "液体输送、试剂转移、加压供液、较长管路输送、阻力较高液路模块",
  "modelDisplay": "型号：DPL30H 标准型号",

  "seriesId": "DPL60",

  "displayName": "DPL60 液体隔膜泵",
  "path": "/products/pumps/diaphragm-pumps/dpl60-liquid-diaphragm-pump",
  "description": "DPL60 液体隔膜泵是一款适用于较高流量液体输送场景的隔膜泵，主要用于仪器内部清洗液输送、废液抽排、管路冲洗、液体循环和快速排液模块。与 DPL30 相比，DPL60 在相同 100 kPa 额定压力等级下提供更高流量，更适合对输送速度、清洗效率和排液效率要求更高的设备系统。\n\nDPL60 系列额定流量为 600 mL/min，额定压力为 100 kPa，自吸高度为 3 mH₂O，支持有刷电机和无刷电机配置。该系列可用于体外诊断设备、实验室自动化设备、生命科学仪器和分析检测系统中的清洗、排液、供液和液路循环模块。",
  "commonApplications": "清洗液输送、废液抽排、管路冲洗、液体循环、快速排液",

    "displayName": "DPL30 液体隔膜泵",
    "path": "/products/pumps/diaphragm-pumps/dpl30-liquid-diaphragm-pump",
    "description": "DPL30 液体隔膜泵是一款面向仪器内部液路系统的紧凑型液体输送泵，适用于清洗液输送、试剂转移、废液抽排、管路预充和小流量液体循环等场景。该系列采用隔膜泵结构，可在有限空间内实现稳定液体输送，适合体外诊断设备、生命科学仪器、实验室自动化设备和分析检测系统中的液路模块集成。\n\nDPL30 系列额定流量为 300 mL/min，额定压力为 100 kPa，自吸高度为 6 mH₂O，提供有刷电机和无刷电机两种标准型号配置。用户可根据设备运行时间、寿命要求和成本需求直接选择对应型号；如需 12V 电压、FF/PS 材质组合或其他接口方向，可在型号配置中进一步确认。",
    "commonApplications": "清洗液输送、试剂转移、废液抽排、管路预充、小流量液体循环",

        "answer": "EP/PS 适用于常规液体输送场景，配置为 EPDM 膜片、EPDM 阀片和 PPS 泵头。FF/PS 适用于对过液材料要求更高的场景，配置为 PTFE 膜片、FFKM 阀片和 PPS 泵头。实际选型需要根据液体介质、温度、浓度和兼容性测试结果确认。",
        "seoDirection": "EPDM、PTFE、FFKM、PPS 过液材质"
      },
      {
        "question": "DPL30 和 DPL60 怎么选？",
        "answer": "DPL30 和 DPL60 都属于液体隔膜泵，主要区别是流量。DPL30 的流量为 300 mL/min，适合小流量液体输送、废液抽排和管路预充；DPL60 的流量为 600 mL/min，更适合对输送速度、清洗效率和排液效率要求更高的液路系统。如果压力需求相同但需要更大流量，可以优先选择 DPL60。",
        "seoDirection": "DPL30 vs DPL60、300 mL/min、600 mL/min"
      }

    "description": "DPL30H 液体隔膜泵是一款适用于较高出口压力液路系统的隔膜泵，适合用于仪器内部液体输送、试剂转移、加压供液、较长管路输送和阻力较高的液路模块。该系列在 300 mL/min 流量基础上提供 600 kPa 额定压力，适合对出口压力要求高于常规液体隔膜泵的设备系统。\n\nDPL30H 系列支持有刷电机和无刷电机版本，采用卡套接头结构，可连接 6×4 mm 硬管，适合需要稳定管路连接和较高压力输送的仪器内部液路集成。对于需要 300 mL/min 流量、600 kPa 额定压力和硬管连接方式的应用，DPL30H 可作为液体输送、管路供液和加压液路模块的隔膜泵方案。",

    "description": "DPGL800 气液混合隔膜泵是一款适用于气体抽吸、负压建立和气液混合物抽排的无刷隔膜泵，可用于仪器内部负压抽吸模块、废液与气体混合抽排、密闭容器抽气和气路辅助输送等场景。该系列工作介质覆盖气体和气液混合物，适合需要同时考虑气体流量、负压能力和系统集成空间的设备应用。\n\nDPGL800 采用 24V 无刷电机，单头空载流量为 6 L/min，最大正压为 30 kPa，最大负压＜-90 kPa，接口为 G1/8 内螺纹。对于需要较高负压能力、较大气体流量和气液混合物抽排能力的体外诊断设备、实验室自动化设备和分析检测系统，DPGL800 可作为气液混合隔膜泵和负压抽吸泵方案进行集成。",

## 7. 隔膜泵详情页 CSS 检查

.diaphragm-detail-page {
  background: #f6f8fb;
  color: #172033;
}

.diaphragm-detail-inner {
  width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 40px));
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 32px 0 72px;
}

.diaphragm-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #667085;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.diaphragm-breadcrumb a {
  color: #173368;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.diaphragm-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.02fr) minmax(360px, 0.98fr);
  gap: 28px;
  align-items: stretch;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 28px;
}

.diaphragm-hero-media {
  min-height: 360px;
  border: 1px solid #e6ebf2;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc, #eef3f8);
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.diaphragm-hero-media img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}

.diaphragm-media-placeholder {
  text-align: center;
  color: #667085;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.diaphragm-media-placeholder strong {
  display: block;
  color: #173368;
  font-size: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.diaphragm-hero-copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
}

.diaphragm-kicker {
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #09a989;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.diaphragm-title {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
  line-height: 1.12;
  color: #173368;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}

.diaphragm-desc {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: #344054;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
}

.diaphragm-model-line {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.diaphragm-model-line strong {
  color: #173368;
}

.diaphragm-primary-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 0 18px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #173368;
  color: #173368;
  background: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.diaphragm-primary-link:hover {
  background: #173368;
  color: #09e9b4;
}

.diaphragm-section {
  margin-top: 28px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 28px;
}

.diaphragm-section-title {
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  color: #173368;
  font-size: 24px;
}

.diaphragm-applications {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.diaphragm-applications li {
  border: 1px solid #d7deea;
  background: #f8fafc;
  color: #173368;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.diaphragm-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.diaphragm-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 720px;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.diaphragm-table th,
.diaphragm-table td {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  padding: 13px 14px;
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.diaphragm-table th {
  background: #f3f6fa;
  color: #173368;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.diaphragm-table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.diaphragm-subtitle {
  margin: 24px 0 10px;
  color: #173368;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.diaphragm-faq {
  border-top: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  padding: 18px 0;
}

.diaphragm-faq:first-of-type {
  border-top: 0;
  padding-top: 0;
}

.diaphragm-faq h3 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: #173368;
  font-size: 17px;
}

.diaphragm-faq p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #344054;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.diaphragm-media-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.diaphragm-media-item {
  border: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px;
  background: #f8fafc;
}

.diaphragm-media-item strong {
  display: block;
  color: #173368;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.diaphragm-media-item span {
  display: block;
  color: #667085;
  font-size: 13px;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.diaphragm-list-page {
  background: #f6f8fb;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.diaphragm-list-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}

.diaphragm-list-card {
  display: block;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

.diaphragm-list-card:hover {
  border-color: #173368;
}

.diaphragm-list-card h2 {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color: #173368;
  font-size: 20px;
}

.diaphragm-list-card p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #344054;
  line-height: 1.7;
  font-size: 14px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .diaphragm-detail-inner {
    width: min(100% - 24px, 1200px);
    padding-top: 20px;
  }

  .diaphragm-hero {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    padding: 18px;
  }

  .diaphragm-hero-media {
    min-height: 260px;
  }

  .diaphragm-section {
    padding: 18px;
  }

  .diaphragm-media-list,
  .diaphragm-list-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* Diaphragm pump selection page */
.diaphragm-selection-page {
  background: #f6f8fb;
  min-height: 100vh;
  color: #172033;
}

.diaphragm-selection-inner {
  width: min(1280px, calc(100% - 40px));
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 28px 0 72px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-hero {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 28px 32px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-desc {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin: 0;
  color: #344054;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.9;
}

.diaphragm-selection-section {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 24px 28px 28px;
  margin-top: 24px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-section-head h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #173368;
  font-size: 24px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.diaphragm-selection-section-head span {
  color: #667085;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-card {
  border: 1px solid #e4e8ef;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 360px;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}

.diaphragm-selection-card:hover {
  border-color: #173368;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.diaphragm-selection-image {
  height: 180px;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf1f6;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.diaphragm-selection-image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}

.diaphragm-selection-placeholder {
  text-align: center;
  color: #667085;
  line-height: 1.7;
  padding: 20px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-placeholder strong {
  display: block;
  color: #173368;
  font-size: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-body {
  padding: 18px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
}

.diaphragm-selection-body h3 {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color: #173368;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.diaphragm-selection-body p {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: #344054;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.diaphragm-selection-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: auto;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-meta span {
  border: 1px solid #d7deea;
  background: #f8fafc;
  color: #173368;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.diaphragm-selection-detail {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 38px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #173368;
  color: #173368;
  background: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.diaphragm-selection-detail:hover {
  background: #173368;
  color: #09e9b4;
}

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .diaphragm-selection-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .diaphragm-selection-inner {
    width: min(100% - 24px, 1280px);
    padding-top: 20px;
  }

  .diaphragm-selection-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

  .diaphragm-selection-section {
    padding: 18px;
  }

  .diaphragm-selection-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
